decisions.reason: The Remarks used scalar kx and 2pi delta for arbitrary vectors in R^d. Replaced them by the dot product and (2pi)^d delta^(d), defining delta as evaluation on tests and distinguishing the momentum-difference distribution from u_k. The verified Example and its proof are unchanged.

F2 incorrectly transported tensor amplifications through the direct-sum unitary Psi_0; clause (c) uses Theta. Replaced this with the direct-sum identities, explicitly obtained componentwise from clause (a). Steps 1.1, 2.2-2.4 use only these direct-sum identities; the Statement and all operator domains and Fourier/generator claims remain unchanged.

F1 used L2 density of interval tests without a supplier establishing it, and step 1.1 needs that density before forming the adjoint. Added the existing open-set L2 density lemma, applied at n=1, Omega=(0,L), K=C under Countable Choice, to F1 and dependency metadata. Integration by parts, adjoint computation, sine non-eigenvectors and the conditional sharp-observable conclusion remain valid with unchanged public interfaces.

F2 attributed the pointwise integral formula on all L1-intersect-L2 classes to suppliers whose interfaces state it only on Schwartz functions. Corrected this unused overbroad Facts restatement to Schwartz functions and their continuous representatives. Step 2.1 proves the Gaussian is Schwartz before step 3.1 invokes F2, so every Example claim, normalization, width and variance is preserved.

The supplier is kind counterexample and its heading is Statement refuted, not an affirmed existential theorem. Its complete Counterexample proof derives [A,B^n]=n i hbar B^(n-1), then ||B^n||>=c^n n! contradicting ||B||^n on every nonzero H. The remark accurately restates the proved nonexistence; Gaussian, plane-wave and boundary summaries also preserve their suppliers' hypotheses and nonempirical scope. No item edit is warranted.

Current P6 Postulate clause (iii), Species parameters, explicitly states that mass, charge, spin label, statistics and magnetic couplings are empirical model parameters entered as declared values with uncertainty. Its clauses (iv)-(v) preserve the assignment and nonmeasurement qualifications; P5 clause (iii) separately declares m>0 and clause (v) points to empirical species inputs. The rejected paragraph faithfully summarizes these interfaces and derives no measured value. No item edit is warranted.
